messages:
alex: Heads up — we need a short playbook for per-org burst controls that avoids punishing steady small tenants when a single noisy tenant spikes. Thinking we combine short-term smoothing (sliding window token rate) + reactive penalty (token drop for offenders) + coordinated fallback models.
tori: +1. do you mean per-org smoothing budget that refills slowly? was thinking token-bucket with adaptive refill based on historical 95th pct usage.
raj: Love. also need noisy-neighbor detector signals: GPU util, qlen, p99 latency, error-rate, kv-cache-hit drop. If multiple signals spike -> treat as 'noisy'
anya: want to avoid hard 429s for bursty but legitimate onboarding flows. Suggest soft-throttle: 202 + Retry-After + scaled token-cost? or queue with priority for paid tiers.
alex: rough sketch: 1) per-key token-bucket for steady rate 2) per-org smoothing window (60s) that allows bursts up to X tokens but decays budget over 15m 3) noisy-detector escalates to temporary capacity isolation (migrate to dedicated pool or ratelimit)
tori: concretely, bucket capacity = max(1.5x baseline, 10k tokens), refill = baseline per-second. smoothing budget = 5x baseline over 60s, decay half-life 5m.
raj: can we compute baseline from rolling 7d 95pct? avoids penalizing growth. also need metric: 'smoothing_spend' so we can cost-charge.
anya: UX: console should show 'smoothing remaining' per org, with recommended actions and link to commit a dedicated capacity request. put a graph of smoothing_spend + noisy flags.
alex: config proto sketch:
```
route.policy:
  type: smoothing
  window_seconds: 60
  burst_multiplier: 5
  decay_seconds: 300
  noisy_detector_thresholds:
    gpu_util_pct: 80
    qlen: 500
    p99_ms: 1500
```

This will be a feature-flagged rollout.
raj: notes on enforcement: keep per-shard counters for smoothing_budget and use vector clocks to avoid racey double-charges. prefer eventual consistency + per-request idempotency key.
tori: telemetry: add dashboard panels: heatmap of smoothing_spend per-tenant, top offenders, correlation with error-rate and p99; add alert when >5 tenants triggered noisy-detector in 5m.
infra-bot: deploybot: Feature flag 'smoothing-v2' created for org rollout. rollout: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%
anya: rollout plan: start with internal orgs + a couple of high-usage PLG accounts, observe smoothing_spend, false-positive noisy detections, and latency regressions.
alex: experiment matrix: A/B routes = current throttle vs smoothing. measure p95 latency, tokens served, number of 429s, revenue delta. target: reduce 429s for non-offenders by 40%.
raj: one more: per-org smoothing should respect per-key overrides (support admin API to pin a key to 'unthrottled' for infra owners). track audit log.
tori: corner case: org with many keys sharding budget across keys might abuse. solution: cap per-key share = min(key_bucket, org_budget/N_active_keys).
anya: ops play: when noisy-detector triggers, auto-create incident with suggested mitigation: throttle key, migrate to dedicated, or ask user to reduce concurrency.
alex: ok I'll draft a short RFC and a console mock. assigning self to RFC, @tori will do dashboard mock, @raj will prototype detector. can we confirm ownership?
tori: I can take dashboard mock. will post gliffy later.
raj: prototyping now — will push proto collector to staging tonight.
infra-bot: deploybot: smoothing-v2 rollout: 5% -> 20% at 1792502000
anya: thanks team, please add short notes to runbook once we detect noisy tenant so support can follow steps.
alex: perfect — keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
